maria-ops: Heads up — EU-West-2 bring-up next Wed. We need a concrete soak/load plan and autoscaler tuning before handoff. Who can own?
jonas-sre: I can own the testing window. Planning a 6h soak after a 1h ramp. Want to validate scaling from 5 -> 50 GPU pods.
tara-eng-runtime: +1 on 6h soak. Can we start with traffic shape that mimics production token rates? Long tail seqs matter.
maria-ops: yes — use prod-seq-dist v2. Also no spot preemption during first 12h. Keep minReplicas=5, max=80 for now.
kevin-ml: For autoscaler metric, prefer queue_latency_ms and gpu_utilization combined. Recommend targetGpuUtilization=70, queue_latency target <120ms.
jonas-sre: Agreed. Proposed HPA-ish snippet for custom metrics: ```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2beta2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: infer-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: infer-dep
  minReplicas: 5
  maxReplicas: 80
  metrics:
  - type: Pods
    pods:
      metric:
        name: gpu_util_percent
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "70"
  - type: External
    external:
      metric:
        name: inference_queue_latency_ms
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "120"
```
anna-oncall: Paging thresholds? If queue_latency > 500ms for 2m or gpu_util>95% for 3m. Also alert on OOM at pod level.
jonas-sre: We'll set scale-up cooldown 60s, scale-down stabilization 10m to avoid flapping after ramp.
tara-eng-runtime: Load generator plan: k6 ramp to target concurrency over 1h, hold for 6h, then ramp down 30m. Example run: `k6 run --vus 800 --duration 7h20m emulate.js` (we'll tune VUs to match GPU concurrency).
maria-ops: Can you add a short k6 script that hits the routing layer and includes per-request token counts? We need traces for tail-latency.
kevin-ml: I'll drop a minimal script in the test bucket. Also add a run that simulates long context (3k tokens) at 10% traffic.
sre-runbooks-bot: Reminder: runbook template applied -> /runbooks/region-bootstrap. Confirm dashboards and links in the thread.
jonas-sre: Dashboard checklist:
- Grafana: per-model QPS, p50/p95/p99 latency, queue_latency_ms, gpu_util%, pod_count
- Cost dashboard: estimated hourly GPU spend, requests per GPU
- K8s events panel + pod OOM oom_kills
- Infra logs: k8s scheduler latencies
- Traces: end-to-end from API gateway -> model container
maria-ops: Cost control: enable budget alert at $X/hour to paging channel, and set autoscaler cost-protect mode (prefer scale-in only when cost<threshold).
anna-oncall: Handoff checklist before we declare region GA:
1) Smoke tests green (all routes)
2) Soak completed with <1% error and latency SLO met
3) Runbook links in channel + oncall assigned
4) Capacity reserve: keep 10% headroom for bursts
5) Confirm backup region routing policy
jonas-sre: I'll run an initial dry-run tomorrow with 30m soak to validate instrumentation. Then full run Wed per schedule.
maria-ops: Who's oncall during the soak? @anna-oncall will you take primary for the window?
anna-oncall: I can take primary. @jonas-sre you'll be secondary. I'll create a rotation block in PagerDuty.
kevin-ml: One more — when running load, disable model loading on-demand for new variants; pre-warm the model cache. Use: `kubectl exec -it loader -- /opt/warm.sh model=redwood-v1`
jonas-sre: Noted. Also please avoid any disruptive ops (infra upgrades, node pool changes) for 24h around the soak.
maria-ops: Thanks all. I'll post the final timeline + Zoom link. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've added your checklist items.
